lines.en: I hop, land, hop again.

lines.zh: 整体弹起来，又整个落下。
lines.en: My whole body rises, then drops whole.

lines.zh: 我的紫皮被草叶划得发亮。
lines.en: Grass blades scuff my purple skin to a shine.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳朝你那边去。
lines.en: I hop toward you, one bounce at a time.
I roll once and spring up again.

lines.zh: 路上碰到小石子，我弹开了。
lines.en: I hit a pebble and bounce aside.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地挪，跳不了太远。
lines.en: I shift along; my hops aren't long.

lines.zh: 我的身体被树根弹歪了。
lines.en: A root throws me off course.
One hop and my shadow shakes with me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢跟在你后面，不急。
lines.en: I follow behind you. No hurry.

lines.zh: 我跳到石头上，滑了下去。
lines.en: I hop onto a stone and slide off.

lines.zh: 我往前拱，身体先到，别的后到。
lines.en: My body leads and the rest follows.

lines.zh: 草地太软，我一跳就陷下去。
lines.en: Soft grass sinks under each hop.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，散的又聚了。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and gather myself again.

lines.zh: 我停在离你两跳的地方。
lines.en: I stop two hops from you.

lines.zh: 我拉长了一点，又缩回去。
lines.en: I stretch a little, then settle back.
I sit flat and wobble slowly.

lines.zh: 身体一鼓一瘪，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My body swells and sinks, like breathing.
There's a wet sheen on my surface.

lines.zh: 一只虫子飞进来，又被挤出去。
lines.en: A bug flies in and gets pushed out.

lines.zh: 我什么都不想，只是待着。
lines.en: I think nothing. I just am.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在阴影里深了些。
lines.en: In shadow my color deepens.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，边缘晃了晃。
lines.en: I quiver and my edges shake.

lines.zh: 地上的石子透过我，看得见。
lines.en: The pebbles under me show through.
I flow a little downhill.

lines.zh: 我的影子里装的也是我。
lines.en: There's more of me inside my own shadow.

lines.zh: 我发出一点黏黏的响声。
lines.en: I make a soft squelching sound.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，最像一滩紫水。
lines.en: Held still, I look like a puddle of purple.
You stand a good way above me.
I press against your feet. Cool.
One hop brings me to your waist.
Kick me and I'll come apart.
My eyes are inside my body.
I tilt and look at you.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，我吞得下吗？
lines.en: Could I swallow that thing in your hand?

lines.zh: 我贴在你鞋上，湿了一片。
lines.en: I cling to your boot and leave it wet.

lines.zh: 你别站着不动，那样我会撞上来。
lines.en: Don't stand still. I'd bump into you.

lines.zh: 我一点一点往你那边挪。
lines.en: I edge toward you bit by bit.

lines.zh: 紫色黏液流回去，补上了。
lines.en: Purple slime flows back and fills the gap.
I've spread a little and I'm gathering.
I quiver and gel splashes off.
That shrank me half a size.
I bounce back with a dent in my body.
There's a hollow in me now.

lines.zh: 疼我不好说，只觉得散了。
lines.en: Pain's hard to name. I just feel scattered.
I flatten to the ground and slowly recover.
My purple has gone one shade pale.
A few more and I'm gone.
You're big. I like that better.
I could swallow that.
I creep over, all sticky.
A smell drifts over. Sweet.
My body has opened a little.
Closer and I can wrap around it.
One hop and I want to lunge.

lines.zh: 你要是不小心，就归我了。
lines.en: Careless, and it's mine.
Three hops and I'm on you.
Right. I'm oozing over.
I hit you and bounce off.
You stepped on me and I went flat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢鼓回来，还是圆的。
lines.en: I swell back. Still round.
My gel is on your boots.
I've slid to your heel.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我分成两块又合上。
lines.en: That split me in two. They've joined again.
My slime stretches thin as I give way.
No pain — only my shape changed.
I stick to your leg. Cold.

lines.zh: 你抖了抖腿，我掉下去了。
lines.en: You shook your leg and I fell off.
I stick to your sole and can't lift.

lines.zh: 你甩了两下，我才掉下来。
lines.en: You shook twice before I dropped off.

lines.zh: 我撞完在地上一摊，慢慢聚。
lines.en: I hit and spread out, then gather slowly.
That left me stuck to the wall.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，就成了一块。
lines.en: We press together and become one.
Two purples look even purpler.
I don't understand it. I only hop.
My kind are all over the grass.

lines.zh: 我们互相碰一下，就算认识。
lines.en: A bump and we're acquainted.

lines.zh: 我身体弹性很好，你放心。
lines.en: My body is very elastic. Don't worry.
Hop together and the rhythm matches.
I don't speak. I only move.
When it's dark, we'll go.
Together we're a little bigger.
I wrap it up and take it in.

lines.zh: 石子在我里面慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: The pebble sinks slowly inside me.
I'll keep this bit of gel.

lines.zh: 我吞进去，又吐出来看看。
lines.en: I swallow it, then push it back out to look.
Hard things I can't wrap around.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在头顶上一跳一跳。
lines.en: I balance it on top and hop along.
Whatever falls is mine.

lines.zh: 我身体里多了个东西，晃。
lines.en: Something's inside me now. It shifts.
I digest it. Very slowly.
This is better than pebbles.
You moved, so I hop that way.
One hop and I've fixed on you.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正好在我落点上。
lines.en: You're standing right where I'd land.
My whole body draws taut.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，眼睛在里面转。
lines.en: I watch you, my eyes shifting inside.
Retreat and I'll hop further.
Not much on the grass stops me.

lines.zh: 我数着还有几跳的距离。
lines.en: I count the hops between us.

lines.zh: 我一跳，黏液甩到你脚边。
lines.en: I hop and slime splashes at your feet.

lines.zh: 你身上有我想要的温度。
lines.en: You have warmth I want.
Each hop brings me closer.

lines.zh: 我落在你影子上，凉了些。
lines.en: I land in your shadow. Cooler here.
You go left; I hop left.

lines.zh: 我身体压扁，准备弹出去。
lines.en: I flatten to spring.
You've backed against a stone.

lines.zh: 我弹起来，越过了一丛草。
lines.en: I spring over a tuft of grass.

lines.zh: 地面上我的影子一跳一跳。
lines.en: My shadow bounces along the ground.
Your steps have gone uneven. I can hear.
One more hop and I reach you.
I gather myself into a ball.
I hit you and it's soft.
That nudged you a little.
I press my whole bulk onto you.
Gel smears over your hand.
I bounce off and come back.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我凹进去又鼓出来。
lines.en: You hit me; I dent and swell back.
I hop to the height of your knee.

lines.zh: 这一撞，是我全身的重量。
lines.en: That bump was all my weight.
I bounce in from the side.
After the hit I spread out a little.
Among the grass I swell into a purple blob.

lines.zh: 我先是一小滩，然后才成形。
lines.en: First a puddle, then a shape.
There's water here. Good for me.
I land with a wet slap.
Two of my kind are beside me.
My gel clings to the grass tips.
I rise slowly into roundness.
Flat ground here. Good for hopping.
I try one hop.

lines.zh: 我的紫色在阳光下很亮。
lines.en: My purple is bright in the sun.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我表面结了一层皮。
lines.en: Fire sets a skin on my surface.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，砸成一滩。
lines.en: I fall from a height and splash flat.

lines.zh: 水里我散得开，收不回来。
lines.en: In water I spread out and can't gather.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹成一地碎块。
lines.en: The blast scatters me into pieces.

lines.zh: 洞边冒着紫泡，慢慢合上。
lines.en: The hole bubbles purple and slowly closes.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的身体发硬。
lines.en: That force hardens my body.

lines.zh: 没东西吞，我一天比一天小。
lines.en: Nothing to swallow, so I shrink by the day.
Lightning hits and I shudder all over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面让我落。
lines.en: No ground to land on in the void.
